data.narrative:
Manna Aero is a Series B stage company in the Drones & Autonomous sector that has raised $110M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 8 private peers in the sector, including Elroy Air, Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, and Archer Aviation; no public comparables exist in this nascent category.

Given the absence of sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peers with comparable valuation profiles, the Peer-Median method was not applicable. Stage-Progression methodology was the primary quantitative anchor, applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B to later-stage advancement to the $110M total raised proxy, yielding $209M. This single-method triangulation was bounded by a low estimate of $178M (reflecting downside scenario assumptions) and a high estimate of $240M (reflecting upside case), with the median of $209M as the central point estimate.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $178M to $240M, with $209M as the point estimate. Key uncertainties include the limited depth of same-stage comparable data within the Drones & Autonomous space, which prevents conventional peer median triangulation. Investors should weight this analysis accordingly given reliance on a single methodology and note that follow-on validation against emerging transaction data in this sector would strengthen conviction.
